```{r}
library(nnet)
library(dplyr)
```

# 

```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. All participants
# =====================================================

physeq_all_389 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_all_389) > 0,
  physeq_all_389
)

physeq_all_389

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_all_389)

physeq_all_389 <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_all_389,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_all_389


#
physeq_all_389 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_all_389) > 5,
  physeq_all_389
)

physeq_all_389 


# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_389 <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_all_389))

meta_389 <- meta_389 %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    CD4.Count.1 = as.numeric(CD4.Count.1), #,
    viral_load_binary = as.factor(viral_load_binary),
    therapy_binary = as.factor(therapy_binary),
    logCD4 = as.numeric(log10(meta_389$CD4.Count.1))
  )

meta_389$logCD4_c <- scale(
  log10(meta_389$CD4.Count.1),
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)
# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

colnames(masaliva_LODimputed389_filt)   #plasma #saliva

cyto_389 <- masaliva_LODimputed389_filt[
  rownames(meta_389),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_389_log <- log10(cyto_389 + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. RESIDUALIZE CYTOKINES
#    regress out age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_389 <- apply(
  cyto_389_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex , 
      data = meta_389
    )
    
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_389 <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_389)

rownames(cyto_resid_389) <- rownames(meta_389)

```



# clustering with Mclust (Saliva)

```{r}
cytok <- cyto_resid_389

# keep shared samples only

dim(cytok)
dim(cyto_389_log)
shared_ids <- intersect(rownames(cytok), rownames(meta_389))

length(intersect(rownames(cytok), rownames(meta_389)))

cytok <- cytok[shared_ids, ]
meta_sub     <- meta_389[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok <- cytok %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance vars
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(cytok, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
cytok <- cytok[, vars > 0]



X <- scale(cytok)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(X,
                  center = FALSE, #TRUE,
                  scale. = FALSE) #TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# Scree plot
# -----------------------------
fviz_eig(pca_res,
         addlabels = TRUE,
         ylim = c(0, 60)) +
  ggtitle("Scree Plot")

# -----------------------------
# Variance explained table
# -----------------------------
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================
# Example:
# use enough PCs to explain ~80% variance

n_pcs <- which(cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.8)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")


pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

#pca_scores
# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)
#mc <- Mclust(cyto_HI_log)

summary(mc)

# cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)
clusters
# add to metadata
meta_sub$Mclust_cluster <- clusters
table(meta_sub$Mclust_cluster)



meta_sub_pooled$Mclust_cluster<- factor(meta_sub_pooled$Mclust_cluster, levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
                                        labels = c("PS1", "PS2", "PS3")) 


```




# Association of phenotypes with HIV status

```{r}
# =========================================================
# SALIVA
# Adjusted for:
#   caries_IL
#   host_age
#   host_sex
#
# BH correction is applied ONLY to study_group comparisons
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Check distributions
# ---------------------------------------------------------

table(
  meta_sub$Mclust_cluster,
  meta_sub$study_group
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Set reference levels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_sub_ref <- meta_sub %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "2"
    ),
    study_group = relevel(
      factor(study_group),
      ref = "HEU"
    )
  )

levels(meta_sub_ref$Mclust_cluster)
levels(meta_sub_ref$study_group)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Multinomial logistic regression
# ---------------------------------------------------------

logi_study_grp <- multinom(
  Mclust_cluster ~ study_group +
    #caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  data = meta_sub_ref,
  trace = FALSE
)

summary(logi_study_grp)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract coefficients and SEs
# ---------------------------------------------------------

s <- summary(logi_study_grp)

coef <- s$coefficients
se   <- s$standard.errors

# Make sure matrices remain matrices if necessary
coef <- as.matrix(coef)
se   <- as.matrix(se)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate z statistics and P-values
# ---------------------------------------------------------

z <- coef / se

p <- 2 * pnorm(
  abs(z),
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Odds ratios and 95% CI
# ---------------------------------------------------------

OR <- exp(coef)

CI_low <- exp(
  coef - 1.96 * se
)

CI_high <- exp(
  coef + 1.96 * se
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Create full results table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_all <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(
    rownames(coef),
    each = ncol(coef)
  ),
  Predictor = rep(
    colnames(coef),
    times = nrow(coef)
  ),
  Estimate = as.vector(t(coef)),
  SE = as.vector(t(se)),
  Z = as.vector(t(z)),
  P = as.vector(t(p)),
  OR = as.vector(t(OR)),
  CI_low = as.vector(t(CI_low)),
  CI_high = as.vector(t(CI_high))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# BH correction ONLY for study_group
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_study_group <- results_all %>%
  filter(
    Predictor %in% c(
      "study_groupHI",
      "study_groupHUU"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    P_BH = p.adjust(
      P,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Final table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_study_group <- results_study_group %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Predictor,
    OR,
    CI_low,
    CI_high,
    P,
    P_BH
  )

results_study_group

```




```{r}

library(nnet)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Set reference levels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_sub_ref <- meta_sub %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "2"
    ),
    study_group = relevel(
      factor(study_group),
      ref = "HEU"
    ),
    host_sex = relevel(
      factor(host_sex),
      ref = "F"
    )
  )

# Check cluster labels and reference levels
levels(meta_sub_ref$Mclust_cluster)
levels(meta_sub_ref$study_group)
levels(meta_sub_ref$host_sex)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Fit multinomial logistic regression
# ---------------------------------------------------------

logi_study_grp <- multinom(
  Mclust_cluster ~ study_group + host_age + host_sex,
  data = meta_sub_ref,
  trace = FALSE
)

s <- summary(logi_study_grp)

coef <- as.matrix(s$coefficients)
se   <- as.matrix(s$standard.errors)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract all model coefficients
# ---------------------------------------------------------

z <- coef / se
p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)

OR      <- exp(coef)
CI_low  <- exp(coef - 1.96 * se)
CI_high <- exp(coef + 1.96 * se)

results_all <- expand.grid(
  Predictor = colnames(coef),
  Comparison = rownames(coef),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate = as.vector(t(coef)),
    SE       = as.vector(t(se)),
    Z        = as.vector(t(z)),
    P        = as.vector(t(p)),
    OR       = as.vector(t(OR)),
    CI_low   = as.vector(t(CI_low)),
    CI_high  = as.vector(t(CI_high))
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all model coefficients
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_all<- results_all%>%
  mutate(
    P_BH = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Format final results table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_table <- results_all%>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = case_when(
      Comparison == "1" ~ "PS1 vs PS2",
      Comparison == "3" ~ "PS3 vs PS2",
      TRUE ~ Comparison
    ),
    Predictor = recode(
      Predictor,
      "study_groupHI" = "HI vs HEU",
      "study_groupHUU" = "HUU vs HEU",
      "host_age" = "Age",
      "host_sexM" = "Male vs Female"
    ),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      "%.3f-%.3f",
      CI_low,
      CI_high
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Predictor,
    OR,
    `95% CI`,
    P,
    P_BH
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OR = round(OR, 3),
    P = signif(P, 4),
    P_BH = signif(P_BH, 4)
  )

results_table

```

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Set PS1 and HEU as reference levels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_sub_refS1_refHEU <- meta_sub %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "1"
    ),
    study_group = relevel(
      factor(study_group),
      ref = "HEU"
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Fit multinomial logistic regression
# ---------------------------------------------------------

logi_study_grp_S1 <- multinom(
  Mclust_cluster ~ study_group + host_age + host_sex,
  data = meta_sub_refS1_refHEU,
  trace = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract coefficients, SEs, and p-values
# ---------------------------------------------------------

s <- summary(logi_study_grp_S1)

coef <- as.matrix(s$coefficients)
se   <- as.matrix(s$standard.errors)

z <- coef / se
p <- 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)

OR      <- exp(coef)
CI_low  <- exp(coef - 1.96 * se)
CI_high <- exp(coef + 1.96 * se)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Create results table
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_S1 <- data.frame(
  Comparison = rep(rownames(coef), each = ncol(coef)),
  Predictor  = rep(colnames(coef), times = nrow(coef)),
  Estimate   = as.vector(t(coef)),
  SE         = as.vector(t(se)),
  Z          = as.vector(t(z)),
  P          = as.vector(t(p)),
  OR         = as.vector(t(OR)),
  CI_low     = as.vector(t(CI_low)),
  CI_high    = as.vector(t(CI_high))
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# BH correction across all coefficients in this model
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_S1$P_BH <- p.adjust(
  results_S1$P,
  method = "BH"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Keep PS3 vs PS1 comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_PS3_vs_PS1 <- results_S1 %>%
  filter(Comparison == "3") %>%
  mutate(
    Comparison = "PS3 vs PS1",
    Predictor = recode(
      Predictor,
      "study_groupHI" = "HI vs HEU",
      "study_groupHUU" = "HUU vs HEU",
      "host_age" = "Age",
      "host_sexM" = "Male vs Female"
    ),
    `95% CI` = sprintf(
      "%.3f-%.3f",
      CI_low,
      CI_high
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Comparison,
    Predictor,
    OR,
    `95% CI`,
    P,
    P_BH
  )

results_PS3_vs_PS1
```

# Table 6

# HUU  specific caries saliva
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
 
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# HUU
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_HUU <- meta_sub %>%
  filter(study_group == "HUU")

table(meta_HUU$Mclust_cluster)

# =========================================================
# Reference = 2
# Gives comparisons: 1 vs 2 and 3 vs 2
# =========================================================

meta_HUU_ref2 <- meta_HUU %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "1"
    )
  )

fit_ref2 <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ Mclust_cluster +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_HUU_ref2
)

summary(fit_ref2 )


res_ref2 <- broom::tidy(
  fit_ref2,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^Mclust_cluster", term))


# =========================================================
# Reference = 1
# Gives comparison: 3 vs 1
# =========================================================

meta_HUU_ref1 <- meta_HUU %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "2"
    )
  )

fit_ref1 <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ Mclust_cluster +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_HUU_ref1
)

res_ref1 <- broom::tidy(
  fit_ref1,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^Mclust_cluster", term))


# =========================================================
# Extract the 3 unique comparisons
# =========================================================

results_3 <- bind_rows(

  # 1 vs 2
  res_ref2 %>%
    filter(term == "Mclust_cluster1") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "1 vs 2",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    ),

  # 3 vs 2
  res_ref2 %>%
    filter(term == "Mclust_cluster3") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "3 vs 2",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    ),

  # 3 vs 1
  res_ref1 %>%
    filter(term == "Mclust_cluster3") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "3 vs 1",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

results_3
```

# HUU caries plasma
```{r}
# =========================================================
# HUU: Caries outcome — plasma phenotypes
# Reference = PP1
# Comparison = PP2 vs PP1
# Adjusted for age and sex
# =========================================================

meta_HUU <- meta_sub %>%
  filter(study_group == "HUU")

table(meta_HUU$Mclust_cluster)


# =========================================================
# Reference = PP1
# =========================================================

meta_HUU_ref1 <- meta_HUU %>%
  mutate(
    Mclust_cluster = relevel(
      factor(Mclust_cluster),
      ref = "1"
    )
  )

fit_caries_HUU_plasma <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ Mclust_cluster +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_HUU_ref1
)

summary(fit_caries_HUU_plasma)


# =========================================================
```

# PERMANOVA of Bray-Curtis community composition in pooled saliva phenotypes

```{r}

### Make  physeq_pooled_clust from physeq_HI and meta_sub
physeq_pooled <- physeq_all_389
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_pooled)) {
  physeq_pooled <- t(physeq_pooled)
}
physeq_pooled

head(data.frame(otu_table(physeq_pooled)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub$caries_IL)
meta_sub$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub$host_sex)
rownames(meta_sub) <- meta_sub$host_subject_id


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Check whether sample IDs are in exactly the same order
identical(
  rownames(sample_data(physeq_pooled)),
  rownames(meta_sub)
)
sample_data(physeq_pooled) <- sample_data(meta_sub) 

physeq_pooled


# =========================================================
# PCoA: Salivary immune phenotypes
# Bray-Curtis + centroids + spider lines + 95% ellipses
# + adjusted PERMANOVA R2 and p-value
# =========================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Relative abundance
# ---------------------------------------------------------

physeq_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  physeq_pooled,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)

physeq_rel <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_rel) > 0,
  physeq_rel
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------

bray_pooled <- phyloseq::distance(
  physeq_rel,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_pooled <- data.frame(
  sample_data(physeq_rel)
)

meta_pooled$Mclust_cluster <- factor(
  meta_pooled$Mclust_cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3")
)

meta_pooled$study_group <- factor(
  meta_pooled$study_group,
  levels = c("HEU", "HUU", "HI")
)

meta_pooled$caries_IL <- factor(
  meta_pooled$caries_IL,
  levels = c(0, 1)
)

meta_pooled$host_sex <- factor(
  meta_pooled$host_sex
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pcoa_res <- ordinate(
  physeq_rel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_pooled
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Extract PCoA coordinates
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pcoa_coords <- as.data.frame(
  pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2]
)

pcoa_coords$Sample <- rownames(pcoa_coords)

colnames(pcoa_coords)[1:2] <- c(
  "PCoA1",
  "PCoA2"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Add metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_pooled$Sample <- rownames(meta_pooled)

pcoa_df <- left_join(
  pcoa_coords,
  meta_pooled,
  by = "Sample"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Salivary phenotype labels
# ---------------------------------------------------------

pcoa_df$Mclust_cluster <- factor(
  pcoa_df$Mclust_cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
  labels = c("PS1", "PS2", "PS3")
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Variance explained
# ---------------------------------------------------------

eig <- pcoa_res$values$Eigenvalues

pc1_var <- round(
  100 * eig[1] / sum(eig[eig > 0]),
  1
)

pc2_var <- round(
  100 * eig[2] / sum(eig[eig > 0]),
  1
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

permanova <- adonis2(
  bray_pooled ~
    Mclust_cluster +
    study_group +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  data = meta_pooled,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

print(permanova)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Extract phenotype R2 and p-value
# ---------------------------------------------------------

r2_phenotype <- permanova[
  "Mclust_cluster",
  "R2"
]

p_phenotype <- permanova[
  "Mclust_cluster",
  "Pr(>F)"
]

p_label <- ifelse(
  p_phenotype < 0.001,
  "PERMANOVA: R² = 0.XXX, p < 0.001",
  paste0(
    "PERMANOVA: R² = ",
    round(r2_phenotype, 3),
    ", p = ",
    format.pval(
      p_phenotype,
      digits = 3,
      eps = 0.001
    )
  )
)

# Replace the placeholder R2 if p < 0.001
p_label <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA: R² = ",
  round(r2_phenotype, 3),
  ", p ",
  ifelse(
    p_phenotype < 0.001,
    "< 0.001",
    paste0(
      "= ",
      format.pval(
        p_phenotype,
        digits = 3,
        eps = 0.001
      )
    )
  )
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Calculate cluster centroids
# ---------------------------------------------------------

centroids <- pcoa_df %>%
  group_by(Mclust_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Colors
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cluster_colors <- c(
  "PS1" = "#D73027",
  "PS2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "PS3" = "#1B9E77"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 13. PCoA plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_pcoa <- ggplot(
  pcoa_df,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2,
    color = Mclust_cluster
  )
) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Spider lines: samples → cluster centroid
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  geom_segment(
    data = pcoa_df %>%
      left_join(
        centroids,
        by = "Mclust_cluster",
        suffix = c("", "_centroid")
      ),
    aes(
      xend = PCoA1_centroid,
      yend = PCoA2_centroid,
      color = Mclust_cluster
    ),
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = Mclust_cluster
    ),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Sample points
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster centroids
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PCoA1,
      y = PCoA2,
      fill = Mclust_cluster
    ),
    shape = 23,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Centroid labels
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  geom_text(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PCoA1,
      y = PCoA2,
      label = Mclust_cluster
    ),
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    vjust = -1.2
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Colors
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    name = "Salivary Phenotype"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Labels
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA1 (",
      pc1_var,
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA2 (",
      pc2_var,
      "%)"
    )
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # PERMANOVA annotation
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = p_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Theme
  # -------------------------------------------------------
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Print plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

p_pcoa

```

# Cross compartmental phenotypes overall tests (chisq , fisher), propotions
# 6 X 3 cross comp by study group
```{r}

# =========================================================
# Cross-compartment phenotype × study group
# =========================================================

tab_pspp <- table(
  meta_pspp$PSPP,
  meta_pspp$study_group
)

print(tab_pspp)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Chi-square test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

chi_pspp <- chisq.test(tab_pspp)

print(chi_pspp)

# Expected counts
print(chi_pspp$expected)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Fisher's exact test with Monte Carlo simulation
# ---------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(123)

fisher_pspp <- fisher.test(
  tab_pspp,
  simulate.p.value = TRUE,
  B = 100000
)

print(fisher_pspp)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Cramér's V
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(rstatix)

cramers_v_pspp <- cramers_v(tab_pspp)

print(cramers_v_pspp)


### calulate cramer's v directly
# =========================================================
# Cramér's V
# =========================================================

chi_sq <- chi_pspp$statistic
n <- sum(tab_pspp)

r <- nrow(tab_pspp)
k <- ncol(tab_pspp)

cramers_v_pspp <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(chi_sq) / (n * min(r - 1, k - 1))
)

cramers_v_pspp


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Row percentages
# ---------------------------------------------------------

row_percent_pspp <- round(
  prop.table(tab_pspp, margin = 1) * 100,
  1
)

print(row_percent_pspp)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Column percentages
# ---------------------------------------------------------

column_percent_pspp <- round(
  prop.table(tab_pspp, margin = 2) * 100,
  1
)

print(column_percent_pspp)

```

### PS3PP2 logistic regression 

```{r}
# =========================================================
# PS3PP2 enrichment by HIV exposure/infection group
# =========================================================

meta_pspp <- meta_pspp %>%
  mutate(
    PS3PP2_binary = ifelse(PSPP == "PS3PP2", "PS3PP2", "Other"),
    PS3PP2_binary = factor(
      PS3PP2_binary,
      levels = c("Other", "PS3PP2")
    ),
    study_group = factor(
      study_group,
      levels = c("HUU", "HEU", "HI")
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Cross-tabulation
# ---------------------------------------------------------

tab_PS3PP2 <- table(
  meta_pspp$PS3PP2_binary,
  meta_pspp$study_group
)

print(tab_PS3PP2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Column percentages
#    = proportion of each study group that is PS3PP2
# ---------------------------------------------------------

PS3PP2_percent <- round(
  prop.table(tab_PS3PP2, margin = 2) * 100,
  1
)

print(PS3PP2_percent)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Overall test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

fisher_PS3PP2 <- fisher.test(
  tab_PS3PP2,
  simulate.p.value = TRUE,
  B = 100000
)

print(fisher_PS3PP2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Logistic regression
#    Outcome = PS3PP2 vs Other
#    Reference = HUU
# ---------------------------------------------------------

fit_PS3PP2 <- glm(
  PS3PP2_binary ~ study_group +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_pspp
)

summary(fit_PS3PP2)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Odds ratios and 95% CI
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_PS3PP2 <- broom::tidy(
  fit_PS3PP2,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^study_group", term)) %>%
  transmute(
    comparison = term,
    OR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    p = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

print(results_PS3PP2)

```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# PS3PP2 vs Other
# All 3 study-group comparisons
# Adjusted for age and sex
# =========================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Reference = HUU
# Gives: HEU vs HUU and HI vs HUU
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_ref_HUU <- meta_pspp %>%
  mutate(
    study_group = relevel(
      factor(study_group),
      ref = "HUU"
    )
  )

fit_HUU <- glm(
  PS3PP2_binary ~ study_group +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_ref_HUU
)

res_HUU <- broom::tidy(
  fit_HUU,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^study_group", term))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Reference = HEU
# Gives: HUU vs HEU and HI vs HEU
# ---------------------------------------------------------

meta_ref_HEU <- meta_pspp %>%
  mutate(
    study_group = relevel(
      factor(study_group),
      ref = "HEU"
    )
  )

fit_HEU <- glm(
  PS3PP2_binary ~ study_group +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_ref_HEU
)

res_HEU <- broom::tidy(
  fit_HEU,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^study_group", term))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract the 3 unique comparisons
# ---------------------------------------------------------

results_PS3PP2_3 <- bind_rows(

  # HEU vs HUU
  res_HUU %>%
    filter(term == "study_groupHEU") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "HEU vs HUU",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    ),

  # HI vs HUU
  res_HUU %>%
    filter(term == "study_groupHI") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "HI vs HUU",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    ),

  # HI vs HEU
  res_HEU %>%
    filter(term == "study_groupHI") %>%
    transmute(
      comparison = "HI vs HEU",
      OR = estimate,
      CI_low = conf.low,
      CI_high = conf.high,
      p = p.value
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

print(results_PS3PP2_3)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pooled analysis: four PSPP phenotypes
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================
# Set PS3PP2 as reference

# PS2PP1 vs PS3PP2
# =========================================================

meta_pooled_ref <- meta_pspp_4 %>%
  mutate(
    PSPP = relevel(
      factor(PSPP),
      ref = "PS3PP2"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Logistic regression
# =========================================================

fit_pspp <- glm(
  caries_IL ~ PSPP +
    study_group +
    host_age +
    host_sex,
  family = binomial,
  data = meta_pooled_ref
)


summary(fit_pspp)

# =========================================================
# Extract PSPP comparisons
# =========================================================

results_pspp <- broom::tidy(
  fit_pspp,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(grepl("^PSPP", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = case_when(
      term == "PSPPPS1PP1" ~ "PS1PP1 vs PS3PP2",
      term == "PSPPPS1PP2" ~ "PS1PP2 vs PS3PP2",
      term == "PSPPPS2PP1" ~ "PS2PP1 vs PS3PP2",
      TRUE ~ term
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    comparison,
    OR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    p = p.value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(q)

results_pspp

```





#Community composition in cross-compartmental phenotypes Pairwise PERMANOVA of Bray-Curtis beta diversity adjusted for HIV group , age and sex
# cross compartmental pooled all 6 saliva-plasma combinations

```{r}

# pooled bray cross compartmental

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ================================
# Match metadata to phyloseq samples
# ================================
meta <- meta_pspp[sample_names(physeq_all_389), , drop = FALSE]
sample_data(physeq_all_389) <- sample_data(meta)

physeq_all_389

# ================================
# Bray-Curtis + PCoA
# ================================
bray <- phyloseq::distance(
  physeq_all_389,
  method = "bray"
)

pcoa_bray <- ordinate(
  physeq_all_389,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray
)

# PCoA plot colored by PSPP
p_bray <- plot_ordination(
  physeq_all_389,
  pcoa_bray,
  color = "PSPP"
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(color = PSPP),
    type = "t",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    level = 0.95
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Bray-Curtis PCoA",
    color = "PS-PP cluster"
  )

print(p_bray)


# ================================
# Overall PERMANOVA
# Bray ~ PSPP + host_age + host_sex
# ================================
meta_adonis <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_all_389))

meta_adonis$PSPP <- factor(meta_adonis$PSPP)
meta_adonis$host_sex <- factor(meta_adonis$host_sex)
meta_adonis$host_age <- as.numeric(meta_adonis$host_age)

set.seed(123)
adonis_bray <- adonis2(
  bray ~ PSPP + study_group  + host_age + host_sex ,
  data = meta_adonis,
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "margin"
)

print(adonis_bray)

## BH for overall PERMANOVA

# Extract marginal tests and BH-adjust P-values
adonis_table <- as.data.frame(adonis_bray)

# BH correction across model terms
adonis_table$q_value <- NA_real_

# Exclude Residual and Total rows
test_rows <- !(rownames(adonis_table) %in% c("Residual", "Total"))

adonis_table$q_value[test_rows] <- p.adjust(
  adonis_table$`Pr(>F)`[test_rows],
  method = "BH"
)

# Round for presentation
adonis_table$`P-value` <- adonis_table$`Pr(>F)`
adonis_table$`q-value` <- adonis_table$q_value

adonis_table <- adonis_table[
  test_rows,
  c("Df", "SumOfSqs", "R2", "F", "P-value", "q-value")
]

adonis_table


# ================================
# Pairwise PERMANOVA for PSPP
# Adjusted for host_age + host_sex
# ================================

pspp_levels <- levels(droplevels(meta_adonis$PSPP))

pairwise_results <- lapply(
  combn(pspp_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE),
  function(groups) {
    
    keep <- meta_adonis$PSPP %in% groups
    
    meta_pair <- droplevels(meta_adonis[keep, , drop = FALSE])
    bray_pair <- as.dist(as.matrix(bray)[keep, keep])
    
    set.seed(123)
    result <- adonis2(
      bray_pair ~ PSPP + study_group + host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_pair,
      permutations = 9999,
      by = "margin"
    )
    
    data.frame(
      group1 = groups[1],
      group2 = groups[2],
      n1 = sum(meta_pair$PSPP == groups[1]),
      n2 = sum(meta_pair$PSPP == groups[2]),
      R2 = result["PSPP", "R2"],
      F = result["PSPP", "F"],
      p = result["PSPP", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

print(pairwise_results)


# ================================
# Homogeneity of dispersion
# ================================
disp_pspp <- betadisper(
  bray,
  meta_adonis$PSPP
)

print(anova(disp_pspp))

print(
  permutest(
    disp_pspp,
    permutations = 999
  )
)

```





# Bray PSPP 4 
```{r}
# =========================================================
# PCoA: Cross-compartmental immune phenotypes
# Bray-Curtis + centroids + spider lines + 95% ellipses
# =========================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# =========================================================
# 1. Define phenotypes to include
# =========================================================

pspp_keep <- c(
  "PS1PP1",
  "PS1PP2",
  "PS2PP1",
  "PS3PP2"
)

# =========================================================
# 2. Adjustable colors
# =========================================================

pspp_colors <- c(
  "PS1PP1" = "#D73027",
  "PS1PP2" = "#2C7BB6",
  "PS2PP1" = "#1B9E77",
  "PS3PP2" = "#FDAE61"
)

# =========================================================
# 3. Subset phyloseq object
# =========================================================

physeq_pspp4 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  PSPP %in% pspp_keep
)

# Remove taxa absent after subsetting
physeq_pspp4 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_pspp4) > 0,
  physeq_pspp4
)

# Make PSPP a factor
sample_data(physeq_pspp4)$PSPP <- factor(
  sample_data(physeq_pspp4)$PSPP,
  levels = pspp_keep
)

# Check sample numbers
table(
  sample_data(physeq_pspp4)$PSPP
)

# =========================================================
# 4. Bray-Curtis distance
# =========================================================

bray_4 <- phyloseq::distance(
  physeq_pspp4,
  method = "bray"
)

# =========================================================
# 5. PCoA
# =========================================================

pcoa_bray_4 <- ordinate(
  physeq_pspp4,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_4
)

# =========================================================
# 6. Extract PCoA coordinates
# =========================================================

pcoa_coords <- as.data.frame(
  pcoa_bray_4$vectors[, 1:2]
)

pcoa_coords$Sample <- rownames(pcoa_coords)

colnames(pcoa_coords)[1:2] <- c(
  "PCoA1",
  "PCoA2"
)

# =========================================================
# 7. Add metadata
# =========================================================

meta_4 <- data.frame(
  sample_data(physeq_pspp4)
)

meta_4$Sample <- rownames(meta_4)

pcoa_df <- left_join(
  pcoa_coords,
  meta_4,
  by = "Sample"
)

# Ensure phenotype ordering
pcoa_df$PSPP <- factor(
  pcoa_df$PSPP,
  levels = pspp_keep
)

# =========================================================
# 8. Variance explained
# =========================================================

eig <- pcoa_bray_4$values$Eigenvalues

pc1_var <- round(
  100 * eig[1] / sum(eig[eig > 0]),
  1
)

pc2_var <- round(
  100 * eig[2] / sum(eig[eig > 0]),
  1
)

# =========================================================
# 9. Calculate phenotype centroids
# =========================================================

centroids <- pcoa_df %>%
  group_by(PSPP) %>%
  summarise(
    PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1, na.rm = TRUE),
    PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# =========================================================
# 10. PCoA plot
# =========================================================

p_bray_4 <- ggplot(
  pcoa_df,
  aes(
    x = PCoA1,
    y = PCoA2,
    color = PSPP
  )
) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Spider lines: samples → phenotype centroid
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  geom_segment(
    data = pcoa_df %>%
      left_join(
        centroids,
        by = "PSPP",
        suffix = c("", "_centroid")
      ),
    aes(
      xend = PCoA1_centroid,
      yend = PCoA2_centroid,
      color = PSPP
    ),
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = PSPP
    ),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Sample points
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point(
    size = 3.2,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Centroids
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PCoA1,
      y = PCoA2,
      fill = PSPP
    ),
    shape = 23,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Centroid labels
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  geom_text(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PCoA1,
      y = PCoA2,
      label = PSPP
    ),
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    vjust = -1.2
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Adjustable colors
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  scale_color_manual(
    values = pspp_colors,
    name = "PS–PP Phenotype"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pspp_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Axis labels
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  labs(
    x = paste0(
      "PCoA1 (",
      pc1_var,
      "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PCoA2 (",
      pc2_var,
      "%)"
    )
  ) +

  # -------------------------------------------------------
  # Theme
  # -------------------------------------------------------

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 15,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# =========================================================
# 11. Print plot
# =========================================================

p_bray_4
```

```{r}
cf_forest_PS1PP1_vs_PS3PP2 <- ggplot(
  df_forest_plot,
  aes(
    x = lfc_PSPPPS1PP1,
    y = feature,
    color = color_group
  )
) +
  
  # 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = CI_low,
      xmax = CI_high
    ),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # Null effect
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "PS1PP1" = "#D73027",
      "PS3PP2" = "#FDAE61"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Log fold change",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Oral-systemic immune phenotype"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "italic"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

cf_forest_PS1PP1_vs_PS3PP2
```

# Forest PS2PP1 vs PS3PP2
```{r}


# =========================================================
# Forest plot: PS2PP1 vs PS3PP2
# =========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data
# ---------------------------------------------------------

df_forest <- PS2PP1_vs_PS3PP2 %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Direction of association
    color_group = case_when(
      lfc_PSPPPS2PP1 < 0 ~ "PS3PP2",
      TRUE ~ "PS2PP1"
    ),
    
    # Clean taxon names
    feature = taxon %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bsp\\.\\b", "sp.") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+(ATCC|DSM|str\\.|F|CS)\\s*\\d+") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+unknown$") %>%
      str_replace(
        "^([A-Z][a-z]+) unknown$",
        "\\1 sp."
      ) %>%
      str_replace(
        "sp\\. oral taxon (\\d+).*",
        "sp. oral taxon \\1"
      ) %>%
      str_squish()
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate 95% confidence intervals
# ---------------------------------------------------------

df_forest <- df_forest %>%
  mutate(
    CI_low = lfc_PSPPPS2PP1 -
      1.96 * se_PSPPPS2PP1,
    
    CI_high = lfc_PSPPPS2PP1 +
      1.96 * se_PSPPPS2PP1
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Keep taxa meeting plotting criteria
# ---------------------------------------------------------

df_forest_plot <- df_forest %>%
  filter(
    q_PSPPPS2PP1 < 0.10#,
    #passed_ss_PSPPPS2PP1 == TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(lfc_PSPPPS2PP1) %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(feature, levels = feature)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Forest plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

cf_forest_PS2PP1_vs_PS3PP2 <- ggplot(
  df_forest_plot,
  aes(
    x = lfc_PSPPPS2PP1,
    y = feature,
    color = color_group
  )
) +
  
  # 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = CI_low,
      xmax = CI_high
    ),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Point estimate
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # Null effect
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "PS2PP1" = "#1B9E77",
      "PS3PP2" = "#FDAE61"
      
    )
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Log fold change",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Oral-systemic immune phenotype"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "italic"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
```
